projects.name: The Crater

steps.25: fill the crater and lay the paving
steps.50: build the fountain and the stalls
steps.75: start the fountain and open the market

lines.25: That's the last of the rubble out! Now we can see what we're working with. Next we fill it. That's going to take a lot of earth.
lines.50: Filled and level! You can walk where the fire was. The paving's going down now. Then the fountain.
lines.75: The fountain's in and the stalls are standing! Nearly there. It's starting to look like Draslin again.

projects.finish: Listen... the fountain's running. The plaza is finished. Draslin has a heart again.

projects.name: The School
projects.finish: The School is open. The children who lost their families have somewhere to be together now. Aldine's running it.

resident.name: Aldine
resident.line: Come in, come in! Wipe your claws. The children have only just finished scrubbing.

projects.name: The Apothecary
projects.finish: The Apothecary's open again. Mirren had the shelves full before we'd hung the door.

resident.name: Mirren
resident.line: The herbs along the south wall came through the fire. Stubborn things. Like me. Remedies are back on the shelf.

projects.name: The Armory
projects.finish: The Armory is finished! Hesk is already sharpening things.

resident.name: Hesk
resident.line: Swords, spears, a new hammer for Oswin. I still don't usually stock armour. Some things the fire couldn't change.

projects.name: The Library
projects.finish: The Library is finished! Xandra's going to cry when she sees it. Don't tell her I said that.

resident.name: Corvin
resident.line: Half the books burned. The other half were down in the cellar. So, half. Half is a beginning.

projects.name: The Art House
projects.finish: The Art House is done! Odette wants to paint me. I said no. She's painting me anyway.

resident.name: Odette
resident.line: I painted the fire. I painted the crater. I painted the plaza. Next I'm painting something boring. Please let something be boring.

projects.name: The Cure-All Kitchen
projects.finish: The Cure-All Kitchen is finished! Smell that? That's Rosalind. That's lunch.

resident.name: Rosalind
resident.line: I love to cook! And I've got a kitchen again! Come back hungry. Dragons always look hungry.

projects.name: The Corner House
projects.finish: The Corner House is finished. Dorran made me keep the squeaky step. I kept the squeaky step.

resident.name: Dorran
resident.line: Rolan built the corner house back exactly as it was. Even the squeaky step. I asked him to keep the squeaky step.

projects.name: Milo's House
projects.finish: Milo's house is finished. He didn't say much. He didn't have to.

resident.name: Milo
resident.line: Th- this is my room again. They put the window in the same place. I asked them to.

projects.name: The Inn
projects.finish: The Inn is open! Beds, a fire, and Garrick pouring drinks. Half the town will sleep there tonight.

resident.name: Garrick
resident.line: First barrel's tapped! Rooms upstairs, same price as before the fire. Well. Nearly the same price.

projects.name: Tel's House
projects.finish: Tel's house is done. He worked on it every day. Didn't stop once.

resident.name: Tel
resident.line: A door that shuts. A roof that doesn't leak. My boy fell asleep before sundown. First time in months.

projects.name: The Dreamer Houses
projects.finish: The Dreamer Houses are finished! Two families, two roofs, a lot of children.

resident.name: Fen
resident.line: I'm gonna be a dragon when I grow up. Mum says I have to be a person first. That's so long.

projects.name: The Walls and Gate
projects.finish: The walls and gate are done! Draslin can lock its door again. Not that we'll need to. I hope.

projects.name: The Streets and Gardens
projects.finish: That's the streets and gardens. Every road, every tree. Draslin is whole again.
